label: Rossum
description: Rossum organization, queue and private document workflows

operations.name: check_connection
operations.description: Read the bound organization; this is resource reachability, not a human identity or full permission proof.

operations.name: get_organization
operations.description: Read closed organization metadata without users, security settings or billing.

operations.name: list_workspaces
operations.description: One organization-scoped cursor page, at most 100 workspaces.

operations.name: get_workspace
operations.description: Verify that the workspace belongs to the bound organization.

operations.name: create_workspace
operations.description: Create a workspace in the bound organization and verify it with a separate GET. Does not create a queue or enable automation.

operations.name: update_workspace
operations.description: Change only the selected workspace name and replacement metadata; verify with a separate GET.

operations.name: delete_empty_workspace
operations.description: Destructive: require an empty bound workspace, DELETE 204, then authenticated GET 404. A provider 409 is a refusal, not successful cleanup.

operations.name: list_queues
operations.description: Read one cursor page for an exact organization-bound workspace.

operations.name: get_queue
operations.description: Read queue identity, status and counts without inbox addresses, hooks, users, connectors or engine settings.

operations.name: update_queue_metadata
operations.description: PATCH only metadata and optional name. Preserve queue automation, extraction, retention, hooks and settings.

operations.name: list_annotations
operations.description: Read private workflow status for one exact queue cursor page; no extracted values, emails or document URLs.

operations.name: get_annotation
operations.description: Read exact queue-bound annotation status and timestamps without content or customer metadata.

operations.name: get_annotation_structure
operations.description: Project field IDs and schema IDs from private structured content. Discard OCR, values, positions and model predictions.

operations.name: get_selected_values
operations.description: Explicit private document data read. Return only requested schema IDs and their validated values. Treat downstream workflow data as confidential; no raw content, binary exports or public links.

operations.name: update_annotation_metadata
operations.description: Change only replacement metadata; do not change workflow status, extraction values or assignees. Existing tenant extensions may observe the update.

operations.name: get_document
operations.description: Read the document referenced by this queue-bound annotation. Return MIME type, IDs and timestamps without filename, storage keys or content URL.

operations.name: update_document_metadata
operations.description: PATCH only replacement metadata on the exact document referenced by this annotation; verify via independent readback.

operations.name: import_document
operations.description: Upload one supplied document. Starts extraction and may trigger configured tenant automation, extensions, or priced processing. Returns an accepted task ID, never a completed import. No URL download or automatic retry.

operations.name: get_import_task
operations.description: GET task with no_redirect=true. Require upload_created and validate its upload's queue and organization. Discard provider detail and arbitrary result URLs.

operations.name: get_upload
operations.description: Read exact bound upload metadata and created document/annotation IDs without content, filenames or user information.
